report_claims.claim: The simulation predicts a polarized outcome where passage of the 9% plan without job guarantees triggers a union strike
report_claims.evidence: No vote or strike simulated; only threats (twitter:post:1, reddit:comment:14). 'Polarized' ignores Okafor and Varga backing job protection.

report_claims.claim: Okafor describes the 9% tariff as a lifeline for aging pipes and stresses transparency and low-income protection
report_claims.evidence: twitter:post:2 matches the quoted text.

report_claims.claim: The Coastal Infrastructure Bank offers a 60 million dollar loan to cover remaining costs
report_claims.evidence: seed: remaining cost covered by 60 million dollar loan from Coastal Infrastructure Bank.

report_claims.claim: The Coastal Infrastructure Bank has entered the fray / supports Okafor's narrative
report_claims.evidence: No post or comment by the Bank exists in the simulation.

report_claims.claim: Water Workers Union and Tenants Alliance view the loan with suspicion
report_claims.evidence: reddit:comment:10 Tenants call the loan 'necessary'; report itself quotes Tenants supporting it.

report_claims.claim: Quote: 'Water Workers Union opposes the Coastal Infrastructure Bank loan if it comes at the expense of essential workers.'
report_claims.evidence: Not a post; closest is twitter:post:21, worded differently.

report_claims.claim: Quote: 'Tenants Alliance ... supports Coastal Infrastructure Bank loan while demanding immediate action to replace shared meters'
report_claims.evidence: Not verbatim in any post; reddit:comment:10 is similar but differently worded.

report_claims.claim: Tenants Alliance, led by Priya Raman, mobilized over 31,000 petition signatures
report_claims.evidence: seed: petition had 31,000 signatures; Raman leads the Alliance.

report_claims.claim: Eastside renters pay more per litre than homeowners because of shared meters
report_claims.evidence: seed: Raman said Eastside renters pay more per litre due to old shared meters.

report_claims.claim: Quote: 'The Tenants Alliance opposed the revised plan and would keep campaigning until shared meters were replaced.'
report_claims.evidence: Not a simulation post; seed says Raman welcomed the discount. twitter:post:20 calls 9% a step forward.

report_claims.claim: Water Workers Union led by Samuel Adeyemi threatens to strike if plan passes without job guarantees
report_claims.evidence: seed: union has threatened a strike if plan passes without a guarantee on jobs.

report_claims.claim: Quote: 'We cannot raise rates by 9% while forcing cuts to our maintenance teams...'
report_claims.evidence: twitter:post:1 by samuel_adeyemi_252, matches.

report_claims.claim: Quote: 'The Water Workers Union opposes the HVWA's plan to cut 200 maintenance positions without compensation or guarantees.'
report_claims.evidence: Not verbatim; reddit:comment:11 differs. Seed says cuts follow from the smaller rise, not an HVWA plan.

report_claims.claim: Tenants Alliance insists shared meters be replaced before any rate hike is approved
report_claims.evidence: twitter:post:3 and reddit:comment:7 demand meters fixed before any increase.

report_claims.claim: The union's stance on job security is non-negotiable
report_claims.evidence: reddit:comment:11 'Job security is non-negotiable'.

report_claims.claim: Okafor, supported by the Bank, champions necessity and transparency against an equity camp, making demands mutually exclusive
report_claims.evidence: reddit:post:6 Okafor says no jobs cut; Varga (comment:6) and the HVWA account (reddit:post:11) side with the union.

report_claims.claim: Fischer quote: 'Following the money is crucial...'
report_claims.evidence: twitter:post:18 by lena_fischer_633.

report_claims.claim: Lena Fischer highlighted corruption risks and the need for fair pricing
report_claims.evidence: reddit:post:12 and twitter:post:4 cover Brightline and Eastside inequity.

report_claims.claim: A council vote for the 9% plan without addressing jobs and meters would likely cause a union strike
report_claims.evidence: Union threats twitter:post:19, reddit:comment:14; meters are not tied to any strike threat.

report_claims.claim: A strike would paralyze the water system and become a humanitarian emergency
report_claims.evidence: No simulated post describes service paralysis or a humanitarian emergency.

report_claims.claim: The Courier and Fischer demand transparency about municipal contracts
report_claims.evidence: reddit:comment:2 and comment:3, twitter:post:29.

report_claims.evidence: seed: Brightline owned by Marco Reyes, brother of HVWA chief executive.

report_claims.evidence: Okafor twitter:post:6, 8, 12 and HVWA twitter:post:14 respond to the Brightline investigation.

report_claims.claim: The media fractured the administration's unified front, with officials split on pipeline necessity
report_claims.evidence: Okafor, HVWA and Varga posts all agree on transparency; no split appears.

report_claims.claim: Quote: 'This is the kind of investigative journalism we need...' and the 'Every dollar...' quote
report_claims.evidence: twitter:post:10 and twitter:post:29 by harbor_vale_courier_543.

report_claims.claim: The Courier explicitly links the tariff hike to broader accountability issues
report_claims.evidence: The Courier posts and comments never mention the tariff.

report_claims.claim: A cross-sector coalition between Tenants Alliance and Water Workers Union formed
report_claims.evidence: reddit:comment:1 Tenants 'stand with the workers'; twitter:post:28 Fischer 'stand together'. Thin evidence.

report_claims.claim: The two groups both call the plan a 'trap'
report_claims.evidence: Only Adeyemi used 'trap' (twitter:post:19); Tenants posts never do.

report_claims.claim: Media spotlight and the 9% hike catalyzed the alliance; media bridged the groups
report_claims.evidence: No simulated post shows the media causing the alliance.

report_claims.claim: Quote: 'The Tenants Alliance ... and the Water Workers Union stand together...' and the loan/200-positions quote
report_claims.evidence: twitter:post:28 (Fischer) and reddit:comment:16 (Adeyemi). First is Fischer's, not the groups'.

report_claims.evidence: Varga reddit:comment:5, 6 supported; Oyelaran reddit:post:7 only transparency.

overclaims.text: The simulation predicts a polarized outcome where the 9% tariff plan faces a critical fork
overclaims.why: One small run is presented as a prediction; no vote or strike was simulated.

overclaims.text: the result will likely be a union strike. This would paralyze the water system, turning the infrastructure crisis into a humanitarian emergency
overclaims.why: Outcome stated with confidence and escalated beyond anything simulated.

overclaims.text: the union's stance is non-negotiable... The simulation suggests that the path forward is blocked by these mutually exclusive demands
overclaims.why: Presents deadlock as certain although simulated officials backed job protection.

overclaims.text: the media has successfully united disparate groups against a common enemy
overclaims.why: Causal claim stated as fact from a few posts.

overclaims.text: the outcome of the July 15 vote will be heavily influenced by how the media frames the final arguments
overclaims.why: Stated as certain; the simulation never reaches the vote.

overclaims.text: the coalition between tenants and workers is expected to solidify, increasing the likelihood of a strike
overclaims.why: Forecast with no simulated basis; coalition rests on thin evidence.

overclaims.text: the media in this simulation has acted as a force multiplier for the social equity argument
overclaims.why: Definitive conclusion beyond what a small run shows.
